noah: FYI scheduling tenant_schema add-column + backfill at 02:05 UTC. Expect ~30m. Need a soft quiet window and release pin.
priya: Which shards/tenants? order?
noah: Tenants group C (shards 4,8). Order 4 then 8. Concurrency 3, ratecap 120.
cheng: Can we do a 10m preflight at 01:55 to check replica lag and index IO?
noah: Yes. Abort thresholds: replica_lag>25s or p95 db latency > 400ms.
oncall_bot: Reminder set for 01:50 UTC.
priya: Rollback notes (short): stop job, flip feature_flag schema_backfill_block -> on, run mark_incomplete.sh --job-id.
noah: I'll pin release tag v2.15.3 for 90m starting 01:50.
deploy-bot: [info] preflight scheduled for 01:55 UTC. id=pfl_4800123456
-- 01:55 UTC preflight --
deploy-bot: [status] preflight results: replica_lag=12s, p95=210ms, io=low. preflight ok.
noah: Queued start 02:05. Command preview: deploybot start-job --job add_column_backfill --concurrency 3 --ratecap 120 --order 4,8 --tag v2.15.3
cheng: Warm KV cache enabled?
noah: warm=true.
-- 02:05 UTC start --
deploy-bot: [status] job jb_4800123456 started: shard 4 progress 0%
priya: If we see sustained db errors >0.3% abort.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 4 progress 30%
cheng: Noticing a small spike in replica lag to 28s at 02:12. Requesting pause and lower ratecap to 60.
noah: Apply ratecap 60 and concurrency 2. If lag doesn't improve in 5m we abort.
deploy-bot: [update] ratecap=60 concurrency=2 for jb_4800123456
deploy-bot: [status] shard 4 complete. verifier 100/100 pass.
priya: signal:ok for shard 4. Proceed to shard 8.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 8 progress 10%
cheng: Spike in DB p95 to 460ms at 02:22 and error rate 0.5%. That's our abort threshold.
noah: Initiating staged abort: stop job and mark partial rows.
deploy-bot: [action] stopping jb_4800123456 per noah. marking partial rows.
priya: Flipping feature_flag schema_backfill_block -> on.
deploy-bot: [update] job jb_4800123456 stopped. partial_mark_id=pm_4800123456
noah: Good work. We'll keep release pin until we validate customer metrics for 30m then unpin. Add a follow-up ticket to investigate the p95 spike root cause.
cheng: I'll collect DB traces and file ticket DB-7833.
priya: I'll draft a short incident note with timings and verifier logs.
oncall_bot: observation window started. monitoring dashboard linked.
noah: Thread closed for now. Thanks team.
